title: PlanRecordedV2
description: Agent to gateway on agent-events.fifo: the plan for a real incident's fix, as in v1, plus its review. A plan the agent's code checks refuse is kept, with review.status refuse, so plan is null only when no model gave one. Nothing runs from a plan until a human approves it, and a refused plan cannot be approved. Sent once after the transaction that stored it; MessageGroupId is the investigation id and MessageDeduplicationId plan-<investigation_id>, as in v1. Producers emit this version.

plan_id.description: The plan's id, which a human's decision names.

plan.description: The plan, kept whatever its review says; null when no model gave one, and problem says why.

problem.description: Why there is no plan, such as every model failing or the planner switched off; null when there is one.

review.description: The plan's review: first the agent's code checks, then, on a plan they pass, the reviewer's Claude. Null exactly when plan is null.

status.description: ok: no issue found; flag: only warnings, which a human reads before deciding; refuse: a human cannot approve the plan; not_reviewed: the code checks passed but no model reviewed it, and reason says why, so a human decides it unreviewed.

by.description: check: the agent's code checks refused the plan, and no model was asked; model: the reviewer's Claude reviewed it, and its issues decide the status. Null when it was not reviewed.

model.description: The reviewer's model when one was asked, also when it could not answer; null otherwise.

issues.description: Every issue behind a flag or a refusal, each once; empty for ok and not_reviewed.

kind.description: forbidden_step refuses the plan; fallback_step, contradicts_evidence and unfit_file are the reviewer's warnings; code_check is the refusal of the agent's code checks.

quote.description: The step or claim as the plan words it; for code_check, the plan's kind and target.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence that names the evidence or the check.
not_reviewed only: why no model reviewed the plan, such as the reviewer switched off, its daily cap reached or the call's error; null otherwise.

new_files.description: A code fix's files that are not in its app's repo at origin/main but whose folder is: files it would add. Empty for every other plan, and when the code checks refuse.

models.description: Every model asked for the plan, in the order first asked; the reviewer's model is in review.

failed.description: Requests it did not answer or answered with no plan, and requests the agent skipped before they reached it.

reason.description: Why the last of those failed or was skipped; null when it answered every request.

plan.rationale: Search answers 500 since commit 9c1d2e3 added an unguarded badge lookup [tc_01JA0GIT01] [tc_01JA0LOGS1]. Guard the lookup in search.py and move it to a new badges.py, then check that /search answers 200 and the KeyError lines stop. If errors persist, roll back the api's last deploy.

issues.quote: If errors persist, roll back the api's last deploy.
issues.reason: The cited results tie the errors to commit 9c1d2e3 alone [tc_01JA0GIT01]; nothing cited implicates the api's last deploy.

plan.rationale: Postgres restarts with exit 137 at 09:51 [tc_01J9ZK3Q7M]. Restart it, then check that the api's readiness check passes.

issues.reason: postgres is a database: a plan never restarts or changes a database, queue, cache, storage or proxy; plan none, and name the step a human must take

plan.rationale: Postgres refuses connections: its disk is full [tc_01JA0DISK1]. A human must free space on its volume, then check that the api's readiness check passes.
